sec-bot: ALERT • S3 cross-account READ detected on bucket `redwood-logs-prod`
sec-bot: Event: GetObject, Resource: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-prod/telemetry/2026-03-20/*, Principal: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/external-ingest-role, IP: 18.205.32.12, time: 2026-03-20T14:00:34Z
alex: seeing this now. is redwood-logs-prod supposed to be readable by that external account?
maria: Not that I know of. Logging should be internal-only. tagging infra/@oncall and @joel-ops
joel: oncall can you confirm if we have any cross-account replication or partner ingest that uses 987654321098?
oncall: checking. No replication jobs owned by infra. quick check of bucket policy in console shows a statement allowing arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/external-ingest-role — looks accidental from last week's vendor onboarding PR.
emmie: ok contain first: add a deny for that principal and enable public access block. quick commands:
emmie: ```
# block public ACLs immediately
aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket redwood-logs-prod --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
# add temporary explicit deny for external role (example policy snippet)
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-logs-prod --policy '
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"DenyExternalIngest","Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/external-ingest-role"},"Action":"s3:*","Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-prod","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-prod/*"]}]}'
```
alex: running the public-access-block now, will apply bucket policy after verification. copying commands to terminal.
alex: (ran) Public access block applied — response OK. preparing policy patch, will include deny.
maria: also check KMS — if objects encrypted with a CMK, external role may have a Grant on the key. run: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-logs-cmk` and `aws kms get-key-policy`
joel: good catch. If key grants exist for that principal, revoke them and rotate CMK access to the account only. add to containment checklist: revoke grants, re-encrypt if necessary.
oncall: policy updated, deny entry added, bucket policy now returns the deny statement in policy. I also removed a leftover ACL that allowed WRITE for the external account.
sec-bot: Alert suppressed for redwood-logs-prod after policy change. No further GetObject events from 987654321098 in the last 10m.
emmie: next steps / post-incident action items:
1) Run CloudTrail S3 data event lookup for the time window to identify objects accessed and any exfiltration: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GetObject --start-time 2026-03-20T13:50:00Z --end-time 2026-03-20T14:10:00Z`
2) List objects touched and snapshot them for forensic copy.
3) Check KMS grants and rotate keys if grant existed.
4) Rotate any long-lived credentials tied to vendor onboarding scripts.
5) Create automated guardrail: deny cross-account GetObject unless role is in allowlist (Lambda to patch policy or SCP).
6) Postmortem and owner: INC-2026 created and assigned to infra-sre (emmie).
maria: I started CloudTrail query and exported matching events to S3 at s3://sec-incident-exports/2078901234/. so far looks like 12 GetObject events on telemetry/2026-03-20/*.
joel: good. Forensics: snapshot the accessed objects to a separate bucket with object lock enabled. use `aws s3 cp --recursive s3://redwood-logs-prod/telemetry/2026-03-20/ s3://forensics-redwood/2078901234/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control`
oncall: ran snapshot copy with object lock retention 30d. copy completed, size ~18MB.
sec-bot: Note: check for related IAM changes — no suspect IAM changes logged in the last 24h.
emmie: action owner notes added to INC-2026. I'll follow up with vendor onboarding team to audit their least-privilege docs and remove the erroneous role grant from their side.
alex: one more: add a KMS policy guard so external principals cannot be granted decrypt for logs CMKs by default.
maria: scheduling a 30min warroom 20m from now to finish triage and confirm no data left the account. invite: #sec-warroom and infra-sre.
joel: thanks everyone. will write short comms for customers if we find any customer data accessed — for now we have no evidence of exfil. :thumbsup:
emmie: postmortem owner here, will run through timeline and remediation and share before EOD. :spiral_calendar_pad:
sec-bot: Incident state: contained -> mitigations applied.
alex: closing thread for now, continue updates in INC-2026 and #sec-warroom. :lock:
